DIAGNOSIS READY: Scabies.

The combination of intense nocturnal itching, linear "red bumps" on the thigh, and the presence of burrows is classic for scabies infestation. While your travel history is noted, the distribution and morphology of the lesions are more indicative of a mite infestation than a vector-borne illness. We do not need further testing at this time to confirm the clinical diagnosis.

Please confirm if you have seen similar symptoms in close contacts or other family members to assess the extent of exposure.
